d:
The Pacers defeated the Knicks, 106-104 tonight in Indiana. Pascal Siakam contributed a team-high 19 points to go with 3 rebounds 2 assists and 2 three pointers, with Aaron Nesmith of the Pacers adding an additional 18 points (7-10 FG, 2-3 3P) in the game. Jalen Brunson finished with a team-high 33 points along with 11 assists for the Knicks in the losing effort. The Pacers improve their record to 5-8 with the win, while the Knicks fall to 6-6 for the season.
